projects.title: MisfitsAI
description: Led product discovery and roadmap planning for MisfitAI Wardrobe Planner, a mobile app that turns users' closet and calendar into daily outfit recommendations for busy students and young professionals.

Conducted structured customer discovery interviews and translated insights into onboarding flows, wardrobe capture requirements, and objection handling that informed landing page copy and in-product messaging.
Partnered with engineers to scope and ship the first recommendation system MVP, defining API contracts, edge cases, and evaluation criteria for calendar and wardrobe based outfit suggestions.

projects.title: Rx.AI
description: Built dynamic AI-powered patient check-in system that generates personalized clinical questionnaires
Integrated voice and camera multimodal features including TTS question playback, real-time STT answer transcription, and inline image capture for wound photos and medication labels
Designed end-to-end evaluation pipeline using DeepEval metrics with a BigQuery data sink to assess STT, TTS, image analysis, and question generation quality across 5 workflow combinations

projects.title: Nutrigraph
description: Built agentic multimodal RAG system that estimates dish macros from images and text using USDA and OpenFoodFacts.
Designed diner and restaurant workflows, including restaurant search, dish logging, nutrition dashboards, and catalog creation.
Added evaluation and feedback loops for macro accuracy, confidence based clarification, and repeated request handling.

projects.title: TaskflowAI
description: Engineered end-to-end agentic workflow system to parse email, intelligently extract tasks and calendar events, categorize by user preferences, and auto-populate productivity tools, reducing manual scheduling overhead.
Designed orchestration layer for multi-agent coordination, enabling seamless integration between task extraction, categorization, and calendar management components.

projects.title: MeetFree
description: Built web application to record and auto-summarize meetings, simplifying manual note-taking for team discussions
Leveraged Google Cloud to establish infra and engineered transcription processing multi-speaker audio via Google Speech-To-Text
Engineered prompt-based summarization service utilizing Gemini to generate concise, structured notes, cutting review time

projects.title: Cybersecurity Jacket
description: A jacket that shows your security breaches by showing whether it passes our security tests by LED colors (Red - fail, Yellow - semi-vulnerable, Green - pass) and showing solution suggestions on a website.
We designed this using a security guard-style jacket and created LED strip designs on the jacket.
What makes this unique is that security awareness education does not involve wearable aspects, and is usually information heavy.
This is a fun way to learn more about how security breaches and safety.

My contribution: Project Manager; Engineered the architecture; Set up the cloud infrastructure; Developed flask application; Developed multiple arduino code bases to connect remotely to internet, scrape a website, find data, communicate beween different modules and the lights

projects.title: Blind Man's Bluff
description: Built a mobile application in flutter to help people who are blind navigate through their daily routine.
Used state of the art real-time object detection and distance estimation to alert the user through vibrations and audio feedback.
Competition: HackMIT 2020

projects.title: COVID Bot
description: Designed, coded, and prototyped an automated mopping robot with UV disinfectant light and Arduino
Used for sanitizing surfaces in hospitals during the COVID-19 outbreak to reduce hospital maintenance staff and the infection rate
Competition: SOS Hackathon 2020
